title: Summary Matches Raw SQL
description: The synchronous summary chart is really just a query over the shipments table with some bucketing math on top — prove its headline totals agree with counting the rows yourself.
successCondition: GET /api/reporting/summary?from=<a from>&to=<a to>&groupBy=day&timeZone=UTC. Querying the shipments table directly via `npm run db:psql` with `select count(*), sum(price_cents) from shipments where created_at >= '<from>' and created_at < '<to>'` confirms the API's totalShipments and totalRevenueCents exactly equal the SQL query's count and sum — the same half-open [from, to) range applies in both.
hints: `to` is exclusive per docs/api/reporting.md — use >= for from and strictly < for to in your SQL to match the API's own semantics exactly.
Pick a from/to range wide enough to include the seeded demo shipments plus anything you've created, so the totals aren't trivially zero.
